candidates.name: 유자 온천
candidates.label: A
candidates.prompt:
Create a production-oriented pixel-art sprite sheet showing EIGHT actual successive IDLE animation frames of ONE capybara game character. The attached penguin images are STYLE REFERENCES only: match their charming detailed chunky pixel clusters, dark indigo outline, pastel highlight shading, substantial cute rounded proportions, and slightly right-facing three-quarter front view. Replace the subject entirely with a CAPYBARA, not a penguin.

Candidate A: "Yuzu Onsen". A plump warm caramel-brown capybara, broad blunt rectangular rounded muzzle unmistakably capybara, tiny round ears, very small dark eyes, rosy cheeks, short sturdy feet, a cream bath towel around its neck, and one small golden yuzu fruit with two green leaves resting on its head. Gentle warm expression, no weapon. Character silhouette is roughly as wide as it is tall, head blends into broad body, rounded hindquarters.

EXACT LAYOUT: 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equally-sized square tiles. Entire image aspect ratio 2:1. Each character entirely contained in its own tile with generous identical padding. Read frames left-to-right across top then bottom. No visible tile borders, separators, text, numbering, watermark or scenery. Consistent flat very pale icy blue background in every tile matching the reference background. Every frame uses exactly the same character scale, position, palette and camera. Feet planted on the exact same tile-relative baseline, fruit never changes shape. Pixel edges are crisp, no antialiasing or blurry illustration.

EIGHT DISTINCT FRAME POSES for a seamless calm idle loop:
1 relaxed body and eyes open.
2 inhale begins, belly expands subtly, head rises one pixel.
3 breath at peak, shoulders rise two pixels, cheeks slightly lifted.
4 body at peak, eyes half-close.
5 eyes fully closed in soft happy arcs, ears tilt very slightly.
6 eyes reopen halfway, belly starts to relax.
7 eyes fully open, body settles.
8 returns exactly to pose 1.
These must be actual coherent animated frames, not eight different character designs or copies of a still. All changes subtle, no jumping or walking. Keep accessories consistent in all eight tiles. Match the reference's small collectible game-sprite feel.
